Radio Marti FAQ

What frequency is Radio Marti on?
In the A-26 season Radio Marti is scheduled on 10 shortwave frequencies, including 6030, 7335, 7365, 7435, 9410, 9805 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 7335 kHz (6 pm – 2 am Eastern). For Europe: 7335 kHz (11 pm – 7 am UTC+1).

Can I hear Radio Marti in the USA?
Yes. Radio Marti is beamed at North America this season on 6030, 7335, 7365, 7435, 9410 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 7335 kHz (6 pm – 2 am Eastern).

Does Radio Marti broadcast in English on shortwave?
Not this season. Radio Marti is scheduled in Spanish.

Is Radio Marti on the air right now?
As of Thursday, September 24, 2026, 10:00 UTC, Radio Marti is scheduled to be broadcasting on 6030 kHz to Cuba. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
